Transcribe selected speech locally using the included whisper.cpp runtime.

## Current Availability {#current-availability}

Desktop builds include the necessary whisper-cpp v1.9.3 engine for macOS arm64, Linux arm64, Linux x64, Windows arm64, and Windows x64. Install this model’s weights via Model Manager, then run the task locally. These are the supported build targets; check the nightly test report for results on a specific package and machine. Note that the desktop build does not include this engine for macOS x64, despite model weights being listed for those platforms.

## Using This Model {#use-this-model}

Open **Analyze → Speech → Transcribe & Captions** on a platform with the required native runtime. Local assistance runs within the desktop editor.

1. Select the speech and install Whisper large-v3 turbo through Manage Models.
2. Explicitly select this speech-recognition model under Tools → Advanced Local Processing when required.
3. Run locally and review both the text and segment boundaries before accepting.

## Download and Requirements {#download-and-requirements}

Model ID: `whisper-large-v3-turbo-ggml`, version **1.0.0**.

Approximate download size: **547.45 MiB**. Minimum system memory: **4 GiB**. This catalog requirement refers to total memory, not currently available memory. Inference also requires sufficient free memory, and installation needs working space; memory is not a guarantee of speed.

Supported platforms: macOS arm64, macOS x64, Linux arm64, Linux x64, Windows arm64, Windows x64. A matching packaged runtime is also essential.

Tools → Model Manager downloads published artifacts and verifies their SHA-256 digests. Processing utilises these installed files locally. Open Storage and verification in Model Manager to inspect notices, repair installations, or change storage locations.

## Packaged Test Verification {#what-the-packaged-test-checks}

Case: `whisper-turbo-transcript`; operation: `speech-recognition`.

Input: A public-domain excerpt from John F. Kennedy’s inaugural address, with a second of silence added at the beginning and end, prepared as mono audio at 16 kHz.

The transcript must contain validly timed, non-empty text within the input audio. Exact wording is not compared.

The nightly-with-tests package downloads real model artifacts and requests inference through the packaged runtime. A required model missing from the catalog will cause the case to fail. Missing native engines will also result in failure on catalog-supported platforms. These comprehensive checks run separately from the standard browser suite. A successful run confirms basic model execution and usable output structure, but does not guarantee perceptual quality or accuracy on your specific recording.

## Result Review {#review-the-result}

- Whisper may produce inaccurate text, especially for noisy recordings or material without clear speech. Listening while reviewing is recommended.
- The test verifies that the real runtime returns a timed, non-empty transcript; it does not ensure a specific spelling or recognition score.
